job: Watch pages for change and see which monitor changed, failed or is paused.
purpose: A list of monitors with three summary tiles, search, an all, active or paused switch and a sort. Each row shows the schedule, what it watches, the last check, a 14-day change sparkline and its status. A row opens a sheet with the diff and timeline; New monitor opens a step dialog for pages, schedule and where to notify.
useWhen: A team tracks changes to external pages and wants to know which ones changed or stopped working.
Each item has a schedule, a status and a history of changes.

avoidWhen.when: The list is every request made, not watched targets.
The page tells the public whether the service is up.
